issue: Every SSE message invalidates the "cockpit" query immediately, so a busy event stream can trigger a refetch storm against the API and race constantly with the 8s polling loop.
fix: Debounce/batch query invalidations or apply tick events to local state and reserve full refetches for reconnects/coarser intervals.

issue: seedTicks() only seeds symbols once and never refreshes existing entries, so if live ticks stop or lag behind polling the UI can display stale prices indefinitely.
fix: Overwrite seeded ticks when a newer polled snapshot arrives or track freshness and clear/reseed ticks on each snapshot refresh.

issue: The status filter checks only row.status, but StatusCell treats entry_triggered as triggered too, so some rows render as TRIGGERED yet disappear from the "Triggered" filter.
fix: Filter on the same derived status used for display, e.g. row.entry_triggered || row.status === selectedStatus.

issue: Selecting a symbol from Prep or Paper Book only stores the ticker, but the drawer renders only when that ticker exists in data.rows; symbols missing from the live cockpit silently fail to open.
fix: Make the drawer load by symbol independently of the live tape row or fetch fallback detail when selectedRow is missing.

issue: If lightweight-charts fails to import or initialize, the catch block leaves a blank chart area because render state never switches to an error/empty placeholder.
fix: Track chart init failure in component state and render EmptyChart when the dynamic import or chart setup throws.

issue: The fallback autoPhase heuristic uses only the ET hour, so 09:00-09:29 ET and non-trading days can be mislabeled as live market when metadata is absent.
fix: Use full ET session boundaries with minutes and at least a weekday check, or rely on a real market-calendar source for fallback phase detection.

issue: The command-palette actions for "Flatten all positions" and "Trigger scan now" open confirmations whose onConfirm handlers are empty, so the UI claims to perform controls but always no-ops.
fix: Wire those commands to the same api.control handlers used elsewhere or remove/disable them until implemented.

issue: changeClass(0) returns "pos", causing flat moves and zero P/L to render as green gains throughout the UI.
fix: Return "mut" for zero and reserve "pos" for strictly positive values.

issue: The top-bar `paper equity` KPI can never show a value because `api.paper()` hardcodes `equity: null`, and `Cockpit` passes that straight through to `TopBar`.
fix: Populate `PaperResponse.equity` from a backend field or derive it from the latest `/api/paper/equity-curve` point before rendering the header.

issue: The global `ticks` map is never pruned, so symbols that fall out of the cockpit universe accumulate for the lifetime of the session.
fix: Prune `ticks` against the current symbol set during snapshot seeding or add an explicit cleanup path when the universe changes.
